label: 跪姿回身 / 后侧三分之四视角
pose_lead: Grounded pose, kneeling turn-back seen from a rear three-quarter angle:
lower_limbs: Both knees rest on the ground slightly apart, the lower legs folded back and the seat clearly raised off the heels.
upper_limbs: Both arms hang at the sides and slightly behind the body, hands near the ground or close to the thighs.
torso_head: The upper body rotates backward from the pelvis, the shoulder line visibly twisted; the head turns toward the rear side.
weight_silhouette: Weight rests on both knees and lower legs; the counter-twist between hips, waist and shoulders is the point of the pose.
